proves.claim: with the board writer held by another connection, fallbackReclaim returns null in under 200 ms and leaves the lapsed gate job as it was.

cli.io-reclaim.skips-busy-writer.why: Without this test the fallback queued for the writer on nearly every next, 7 s of one builder next at load on 20 Nov.

proves.claim: with the writer free, a command's fallback reclaim still drives a lapsed gate job one transition.

cli.io-reclaim.drives-when-writer-free.why: Without this test the no-wait probe could silently stop the fallback from ever reclaiming.

proves.claim: with 400 finished gate jobs and one lapsed job, a fallback reclaim that meets a held writer stays under 200 ms.

cli.io-reclaim.cost-flat-with-lapsed-his.why: Without this test the fallback's cost could grow with gate history while it still skipped the write.
